description: Market cap, volume, open interest, funding rate and price for a coin AS OF a chosen point in the past. Returns a single snapshot, not a series: call it once per point you want to compare (e.g. amount=7 interval=d for a week ago, then again with no offset for now). Use this to answer "how has funding/open interest changed since…".

amount.description: How far back to look, in units of `interval`. Omit for the most recent snapshot.

interval.description: Unit for `amount`: h (hours) or d (days). Defaults to hours.

name: get_coin_historical

meta.description: Envelope metadata. Carries `_truncated` when a list was abridged to fit the response budget.

title: Coin metrics at a past point in time
